full_prompt_en: A square decorative cartoon illustration shows a large white cat face in round dark glasses against a densely patterned floral background. The head fills nearly the entire upper and middle frame, leaving only narrow strips of ornament around the ears and cheeks. Its cream-white surface carries faint curling motifs like embossed paper, so even the broad light areas have delicate internal texture. Two upright ears sit at the top, and a large bow overlaps the right ear. The bow mixes deep blue-black with dusty coral red, its round center and patterned loops set off by a thick dark edge. Wide circular glasses stretch across the face, with simple black oval eyes centered behind the lenses. A tiny pink nose rests below the bridge, and three long dark whisker lines extend from each side. The character has no drawn mouth, keeping the expression calm and direct. At the lower edge of the face, a thick ribbed scarf in red, charcoal, and pale stripes wraps around the neck. Beneath it, a navy knitted sweater fills the bottom of the frame. Pale zigzag rows and tiny floral accents run across the fabric, and the central chest carries the readable word "HELLO" in large light letters. Behind the character, dark navy ornament is packed with red flowers, cream petals, and curling pale lines. The pattern becomes especially visible in the upper corners and alongside the lower cheeks, contrasting with the simpler central face. Light is flat and even, with only slight tonal grain in the bow, face, and knit; separation comes chiefly from the strong dark outlines and the value contrast between ivory and navy. The overall composition is tightly centered and playful, combining an immediately readable cartoon silhouette with rich textile-like detail and a restrained red-blue-cream palette.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰性卡通插画描绘一张戴着深色圆框眼镜的白色猫脸，身后是密集的花卉纹样背景。头部几乎填满上半幅和中部，只在耳朵与脸颊周围留下窄窄的装饰带。奶油白表面带有浮雕纸张般的淡淡卷曲纹样，因此宽阔浅色区域也有细腻的内部肌理。两只直立耳朵位于顶部，一个大蝴蝶结覆盖右耳。蝴蝶结混合深蓝黑与灰珊瑚红，圆形结心和带花纹的结环由厚重深色边缘衬出。宽大的圆眼镜横跨面部，简单的黑色椭圆眼睛位于镜片中央。小小的粉色鼻子落在镜桥下方，每侧各伸出三根长长的深色胡须线。角色没有画出嘴巴，使表情平静而直接。脸部下缘，一条红色、炭灰和浅色条纹相间的厚罗纹围巾裹住颈部。其下，深蓝色针织毛衣占据画面底部。浅色锯齿纹和细小花卉点缀横穿衣料，胸口中央用较大的浅色字母写着可辨认的“HELLO”。角色身后，深海军蓝装饰区挤满红花、奶油色花瓣和卷曲的浅色线条。花纹在上方角落和下方脸颊旁尤其清楚，与较简洁的中央面部形成对比。光线平坦均匀，蝴蝶结、脸和针织物上只有轻微的明度颗粒；形体分离主要依靠有力深色轮廓，以及象牙白与海军蓝之间的明度对比。整体构图紧密居中，活泼地结合一眼可读的卡通剪影、丰富的织物式细节和克制的红蓝奶油色调。
style_prompt_en: The decorative illustration places bold simplified shapes over dense textile-like ornament. Thick dark contours keep the primary silhouette instantly readable, while fine curling lines, tiny flowers, and knitted zigzags fill selected surfaces with near-engraved detail. Cream-white occupies the central light mass, deep navy holds the edges and lower area, and dusty coral red appears as repeated small accents. The contrast between open pale space and crowded dark pattern creates a clear hierarchy without needing realistic depth. Flat, even illumination lets line, fill, and texture carry the form; subtle mottling prevents the color fields from feeling mechanically smooth. Rounded geometry and bilateral balance create a friendly stable center, while asymmetrical accents and varied floral scale add movement around it. Borders and surface patterns echo one another across separate areas, making the whole frame feel coordinated. The overall effect is playful, tactile, and highly legible, with ornamental richness contained by strong graphic structure.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅装饰插画把粗壮简化的形状置于密集的织物式纹样之上。厚重深色轮廓使主要剪影一眼可辨，细密卷线、小花与针织锯齿则以近似雕刻的细节填充选定表面。奶油白占据中央浅色体块，深海军蓝稳住边缘和下方，灰珊瑚红作为重复的小重音出现。开放的浅色空间与拥挤的深色花纹形成鲜明层级，无需写实纵深。平坦均匀的光线让线条、填色和肌理承载形体；轻微斑驳防止色面显得机械光滑。圆润几何与左右平衡创造友好的稳定中心，不对称重音和不同尺度的花纹则为周围增添动势。边框和表面纹样在不同区域彼此呼应，使整幅画面协调统一。整体效果活泼、有触感且高度易读，装饰的丰富性被有力的图形结构约束。
theme_en: A white cartoon cat in round glasses and a knitted sweater against floral ornament
theme_zh: 戴圆框眼镜、穿针织毛衣的白色卡通猫与花卉纹样背景
name: Hello Kitty
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
